triage.finding: CYD time_settings.c:48 increment in short-circuit OR
triage.classification: Valid sequenced C operation; no reproduced defect
triage.reason: Left operand at==end is fully evaluated before right operand *at++, and short circuit prevents dereference at end. Pointer is incremented only while strictly inside bounded name. Existing settings host qualification remains the behavioral evidence; no cosmetic rewrite.

triage.classification: Binary record magic, intentional fixed4-byte field
triage.reason: NTIM is an82-byte binary record; record[4] is version1, not a string terminator. No string consumer reads this field; comparisons use memcmp4.
